remarks: Enjoy the convenience of HEAT, hot water, and cooking gas included in your rent  This bright and airy 1-bedroom apartment boasts an updated kitchen featuring sleek new cabinets, stylish countertops, and brand-new stainless steel appliances. The living room and bedroom are both equipped with new wall unit A/C for added comfort year-round. Generous closet space with built-in shelving offers plenty of storage.  Additional amenities include laundry facilities on every floor, a beautifully appointed lobby, and a fully equipped exercise room.  The location is unbeatable-just steps from local shops, restaurants, public transit, and easy access to the Merritt Parkway. Garage parking is included (space 13, and tenants are responsible for electricity).

facts.laundryLoc: Each floor has a laundry room
